featured_reviews.name: Sujal
featured_reviews.review_text:
It wasn’t easy for me when I first started out. I just knew that I loved taking pictures and making people feel beautiful. Over the years, I’ve learned a lot about lighting, posing, and editing, but the most important thing I’ve learned is how to make my clients feel comfortable in front of the camera.

One of my favorite things about being a portrait photographer is getting to know my clients. I love hearing their stories, learning about their lives, and capturing their personalities in my photos. It’s amazing how a simple smile or a particular pose can tell so much about a person.

featured_reviews.name: Sujal Gupta
featured_reviews.review_text:
A photography experience involves learning, practicing, and creating images, ranging from basic skills (camera settings, composition) to advanced techniques, often through workshops, self-study, or mentorship, focusing on capturing moments, telling stories, and developing personal vision, while navigating challenges like client needs or technical issues, and finding fulfillment in the artistic journey. It's about stepping out of your comfort zone to experiment, learn from peers, and share your work to grow, understanding that great photos come from vision, not just the latest gear.
Thank you so much Brighton sir and ajay sir
